violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: -OBSERVED: white chicken (109f) was stored in Alto-Shaam hot box for about 20 minutes.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the white chicken.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. - OBSERVED: hot water temperature at 3-compartment sink was 108f.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent plumbing service and adjust the hot water temperature to 110f or above.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - OBSERVED: a chemical mixing dispenser is connected down stream from a mop sink with an atmospheric vacuum breaker.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS shared information of approved backflow prevention device (hydro system 1951) with CFM. CFM will need to install the approved backflow prevention device on the mop sink within 3 calendar days.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: OBSERVED: there is not air gap between the drain lines of the wash basin and rinse basin of 3-compartment sink and the grease trap.
violations.corrective_action: A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please create air gaps between the drain lines of wash basin and rinse basin of 3-compartment sink and grease trap within 3 calendar days.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED GROUND BEEF AT ~121F IN FAR LEFT ALTOSHAM.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: REHEATED TO 165F.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED SOUP IN BAGS THAWING IN WARM WATER AT FOUR-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: SOUP BAGS PLACED IN WALK-IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cook Temps
violations.observation: Employees are not aware of or are not monitoring the cook temperatures of time/temperature control for safety food. PIC UNAWARE THAT THE COOKING TEMPERATURE FOR CHICKEN WAS 165F AND THAT COMMERCIALLY PROCESSED FOOD REHEATED FOR HOT HOLDING IS 135F.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall be designating employees to monitor the cooking and reheating temperatures of time/temperature control for safety foods. The employees shall be trained in using a calibrated food thermometer to ensure the following foods are cooked and reheated as required: 1) Poultry, turkey, duck, and stuffed foods: cooked to an internal temperature of 165F for 15 seconds, 2) Beef and eggs for hot holding: cooked to an internal temperature of 155F for at least 15 seconds, 3) Pork, seafood, plant foods for hot holding, and eggs for immediate service: cooked to an internal temperature of 145F for at least 15 seconds, 4) Prepared and subsequently cooled foods reheated for hot holding to an internal temperature of 165F for at least 15 seconds, and 5) Commercially processed foods reheated for hot holding to an internal temperature of 135F for at least 15 seconds. CDI: EHS RE-EDUCATED PIC AND WILL PROVIDE HANDOUTS. ALL EMPLOYEES MUST BE RETRAINED ON COOKING AND REHEATING TEMPERATURES.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. OBSERVED NO PROCEDURE FOR CLEAN-UP OF VOMITING AND DIARRHEA.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH CLEAN-UP PROCEDURE.

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Commercially Processed Food
violations.observation: The following ready-to-eat food taken from a commercially processed, hermetically sealed container, or food from an intact package from a food processing plant was not reheated to the proper temperature for hot holding: OBSERVED 2 BAGS OF PROCESSED WHITE CHEESE AND 1 BAG OF COOKED TACO BURGER IN RETHERMALIZER. WATER WAS AT 124F AND UNIT WAS TURNED OFF.
violations.corrective_action: Ready-to-eat food taken from a commercially processed, hermetically sealed container or from an intact package from a food processing plant shall be reheated for hot holding to a minimum temperature of 135F to be maintained in hot hold at 135F or above. CDI: FOOD REHEATED TO 135F AND PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN THE PREP-TOP AT THE SERVICE AREA: CUT LETTUCE AT 45F-50F, POBLANO CREMA AT 44F, SHREDDED MOZZARELLA AT 42F-50F, SALSA 42F-44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS ITEMS MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER.
